serverInfo.name: ReceiptRail
serverInfo.description: x402 delivery receipts on Solana: anchor a SHA-256 digest of delivered content into a Solana PDA after an x402 settlement; buyer agents verify proof of delivery offline, forever, with zero trust in the seller.

tools.name: issue_receipt
tools.description: Anchor an on-chain delivery receipt on Solana (0.001 USDC): commits the SHA-256 digest of delivered content plus the settlement reference into a PDA. Use after an x402 payment settles. Returns receipt id, PDA address, tx signature.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Independently verify a ReceiptRail delivery receipt against Solana on-chain state: recomputes the PDA, compares the anchored digest, returns valid/invalid with tx details. Use to prove what was delivered without trusting the seller.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a ReceiptRail receipt record (anchored digest, settlement ref, tx signature, timestamps) by id for reporting or dispute evidence.
